info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Rosewood Syrup Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Rosewood Syrup Catalog Management API enables businesses to efficiently manage and create detailed entries for rosewood syrup products within their catalog. It allows users to add essential product information, enhancing the accuracy and comprehensiveness of the catalog. Typical consumers of this API include inventory managers and product developers looking to streamline product data submissions. This API ensures that new syrup details are accurately captured and made available for further operations within the inventory system.

post.description: This operation allows you to create and submit new details related to rosewood syrup. You need to provide the necessary data in the request body to successfully create the details.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for the rosewood syrup. It must be formatted in JSON and contain all required fields as specified in the schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested details.

CreateCatalogRosewoodSyrupDetailRequest.title: Rosewood Syrup Request Body

rosewood_syrup_id.description: The unique identifier for the rosewood syrup.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person requesting the rosewood syrup.

quantity.description: The quantity of rosewood syrup being requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is of high priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of rosewood syrup.

tags.description: A list of tags associated with the request.

items.description: A single tag for categorizing the request.
